name: Wellcome Trust
why_them: Capacity (2/2): Wellcome made 711 grant awards worth £1.3bn in 2024/25 and has an active portfolio of 2,723 grants worth £7.3bn. Charity Commission records show £1.63bn expenditure for the year to 30 Sep 2024. Programmatic fit (1/2): Wellcome has a track record of funding youth science engagement. Examples are the Curiosity partnership with BBC Children in Need for disadvantaged children, Science Learning+ for informal science learning, and a £30m science centres fund. Curiosity is now closed. The sources I found are mostly from 2009 to 2018, so I could not confirm any open STEM-education scheme that suits the Nonprofit. Strategic relevance (1/2): Past youth STEM work fits the Nonprofit's mission. Its current priorities are research-led, so a youth outreach grant is not a clear match. Not checked: whether Wellcome is an existing partner of the Nonprofit, because the Nonprofit's annual reports were not available to me. Sector exclusions (defence, gambling, tobacco) do not apply to a health-research charity. I did not review Wellcome's CSR pages directly. This record is based on search results only. Before outreach, check wellcome.org for current schemes and check the annual-report partner list.
